summary: Frontend-only regression + feature verification for Fluxvex landing: new Affiliate 3D money-flow card, polished Integrations strip, and CrossFade3D fresh-load fix across all 8 Scene3D sections. All critical data-testids present, 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390. Fresh-load check: SVG base/3D is visible immediately on scroll to #workflow and #product (no blank frame). Affiliate 3D (affiliate-flow-3d) renders with 'How the money flows' and 'No T&C applied' HTML pills + '20% of every subscription payment' caption. affiliate-step-1..3, affiliate-earnings-card, affiliate-cta-button (opens waitlist), affiliate-contact-link all working. Integrations strip: integrations-status pill text='3 of 5 channels live at launch / LIVE', 'IN BUILD', '68%', '41%' present; integrations-more-cta works. Vision (vision-scene/3d/ai-block), Showcase KPIs, Platform cloud 3D all present. CTA click opens waitlist overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec references a 'referral-feed' testid on the ReferralFeed card but no data-testid is set in Affiliate.jsx (component renders fine, just not addressable by tests). Low priority — add data-testid="referral-feed" to the ReferralFeed root for future test stability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CrossFade3D sections work with 0 console errors. Cookie banner: click 'Accept all' first. The 'How the money flows' / 'No T&C applied' pills are mixed-case in HTML, not all-caps. ReferralFeed card has no data-testid.
